theorems.name: Submission.bf_starProjection_sup_span_unit
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (W : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)) (u : Rn N), u ∈ Wᗮ → ‖u‖ = 1 → ∀ y : Rn N, (W ⊔ Submodule.span ℝ {u}).starProjection y = W.starProjection y + inner ℝ y u • u
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
